title: Measure EXISTS, IN, JOIN DISTINCT and anti-join templates
acceptance_criteria: Membership and absence groups have identical output grain within each valid pair; NULL and duplicate traps are independently detected.
Fanout/selectivity/hit-rate/skew sweeps include enough levels to bound any claimed crossover.
Raw plans and generated reports retain valid/invalid/unsupported cells, replication, resources and topology coverage.
expected_artifacts: membership/absence manifests, results, plans and generated reports
validation: Independent Go oracle and firing read-path controls per topology/phase
>=3 whole-run replication and >=3 trials; seeded interleaving and position controls
Plan/cost/result contract audit; resource, client and placement coverage
Containerized queue audit; HIGH review and main ancestry/tag verification
review_policy: HIGH reviews Decision Log, acceptance and evidence; label self-review if no independent reviewer
